extracted.intended_audience: Primarily journalists and aid providers; also citizen reporters, relief responders, volunteers, journalism students, emergency communication specialists, and academics researching social media.
extracted.subtask_description: A handbook providing actionable advice for newsrooms and aid organisations on preparing for disasters and verifying user-generated content (information, photos, videos) shared during breaking crises. It aims to guide how to sift, verify and report accurate, fact-checked information from the crowd.

rubrics_metrics.name: Crisis verification and accurate reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: When a crisis breaks, trusted sources such as news and aid organisations must sift through and verify the mass of reports being shared and published, and report back to the public with accurate, fact-checked information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disaster preparedness in newsrooms
rubrics_metrics.description: The handbook provides actionable advice to facilitate disaster preparedness in newsrooms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verification and use of crowd-sourced information, photos and videos
rubrics_metrics.description: Best practices for how to verify and use information, photos and videos provided by the crowd.
